messages:
Maria Chen: Heads-up — bringing up orion-v2 (int8) on staging and hit a weird token-map shift for Japanese lines that include ZWJ + emoji. Minimal repro below, happens during detokenize/align step and breaks our eval alignments. Anyone seen this?

Maria Chen: repro input (contains U+200D ZWJ):
```
原稿: 漢字

漢字469 \n# simplified: '漢字
469カタカナ' (ZWJ between)
```

Kenji Sato: Can you paste tokenizer version, model artifact hash, and the token id stream + detok output? That'll help narrow if it's tokenizer vs runtime kernel.

Maria Chen: model: orion-v2 export fc3b2a, quant: int8 (symmetric, per-channel), tokenizer: tokenizers==0.9.2 at export. Token ids + detok:
```
ids: [2142, 889, 3021, 502, 99999, 45]
detok(fp16 baseline): "漢字👩‍💻カタカナ。"
detok(int8 staging): "漢字 👩 　カタカナ。"  <-- extra spaces / emoji split, token index shift at position 3
```

Li Wei: huh. tokenizers 0.9.2 has some non-deterministic handling for ZWJ sequences in the CJK merges we shipped. I ran the same input locally with v0.10.0 and it preserves the emoji as single attachment: detok -> "漢字👩‍💻カタカナ。". On our ja-en devset I'm seeing BLEU ~ -2.8 for int8 vs fp16, most regressions concentrated on examples with emoji, ZWJ, or narrow katakana clusters.

Ajay Patel: We saw a similar alignment problem earlier with katakana + emoji where subtoken boundaries shift and beam re-ranking ends up with wrong token alignment. Two quick asks: 1) is the issue present if you force the tokenizer at inference to use the same version as export? 2) can we repro purely in tokenization (i.e., before model runs)? If tokenization differs, it's not a quant kernel bug but an export pipeline mismatch. Also, try the "keep_zwj" normalization flag or run NFKC normalization during preprocessing as a quick experiment.

EvalBot: Automated eval summary (staging vs baseline):
- metric: BLEU delta = -2.9 (p<0.01)
- metric: chrF delta = -1.6
- sample failure examples: https://internal.redwood.ai/evals/2175001234 (redacted)
Note: 73% of degraded examples contain emoji/ZWJ or mixed katakana/kanji boundaries.

Maria Chen: Plan: 1) run pure tokenization diff (fp16 export tokenizer vs int8 staging tokenizer) on 10k ja samples to quantify mismatch. 2) bisect tokenizer commit used at model export time. 3) try inference with tokenizers v0.10.0 and with preprocessing NFKC to see impact on alignment. 4) if tokenizer change fixes it, we'll rebuild int8 artifact with updated tokenizer and re-run full eval. I'll start 1+2 now and post logs.

Kenji Sato: If you can isolate a tiny deterministic repro, I can add a unit test to the tokenizer suite to lock the behavior and prevent regressions. Also can help coordinate a quick rebuild for the int8 artifact after we confirm. :thumbsup:

Maria Chen: Dropping tokenization diffs + a couple failing examples here shortly. Thanks all. :eyes:
